title: Plan
description: What a promoted dashboard must say, before any tool is asked to say it. A DashboardTarget spells a Plan into one tool; every target is a pure function of this object plus the target's own settings, and contract/cases.json records the bytes each must produce.

name.description: An item name a tool will accept: the title with every non-alphanumeric run replaced by one underscore, trimmed, at most 60 characters.

source.description: The executor source the template ran against; targets use it to decide whether they can bind.

tables.description: schema.table, as the template read them, in template order. Distinct: a self-join reads one table under two aliases, and a repeated entry would make its own columns read as ambiguous with themselves.

columns.description: Per table, the executor's own describe_table output: name and the target-neutral dataType (int64 | double | dateTime | string). Keys are sorted.

name.description: The catalog's name for the column, or Title Case of it.

function.description: The Plan's own vocabulary; a target maps it to its engine (Superset: AVERAGE -> AVG).

dimensions.description: [entity, column] pairs, template order. entity is the bare table name.

slicers.description: [entity, column] per recorded slot. Every target renders each as a filter with NO default.

visual.description: No dimension -> card; one -> bar; several -> table.

comparisonSql.description: The template with its slot predicates dropped; every target's engine must agree with this.
